description: Test cases for evaluating slide-generation skills. Each case is rendered by a Sonnet generator subagent following a skill, then adversarially reviewed by an Opus subagent on visual accuracy and interactivity only (not code quality). Confidence 0-100; iterate until 100 on all cases.

viewport.note: All slides are 1280x720 (16:9). Content must not overflow.

cases.prompt: Create a single title slide for a talk called 'The Deep Ocean: Earth's Last Frontier' by Dr. Maya Chen, Marine Biology Dept. Dark aesthetic with a subtle SVG wave motif at the bottom.

Create a content slide titled 'Why Startups Fail' with exactly 4 reasons, each with an inline SVG icon, a bold heading, and one supporting sentence, arranged in a 2x2 grid. Include a footer with slide number 7.
Create a comparison slide 'Monolith vs Microservices' with a two-column layout, 4 rows of comparison points, and a verdict banner at the bottom recommending microservices for teams over 20 engineers.
Create a slide with an animated SVG solar system: sun at center, 3 planets orbiting at different speeds on visible orbit paths, with labels. Animation must loop forever and be smooth.

Create a slide titled 'CI/CD Pipeline' with an animated SVG flow diagram: 4 stages (Build, Test, Deploy, Monitor) connected by arrows, with a pulse/dot animating along the path from stage to stage in sequence, looping.

Create a slide 'Quarterly Revenue 2025' with an interactive bar chart (Q1: 4.2M, Q2: 5.1M, Q3: 4.8M, Q4: 6.3M). Hovering a bar must show a tooltip with the exact value; clicking a bar must highlight it and update a summary line below the chart.

Create a slide 'Model Accuracy Over Epochs' with an interactive line chart of two series (train, validation) over 10 epochs, a legend that toggles each series on click, and axis labels. Include hover markers showing values.
